items.title: India Insolvency Tribunal Receives Petition Against Foxconn Over $15 Million in Dues
items.snippet: Foxconn’s Indian unit has been hit with an insolvency petition filed by BCD Emprasa LLP before the NCLT Chennai bench over almost $15.3 million in unpaid dues. The row underscores delays in payments to vendors and contractors supporting Foxconn’s operations in Bengaluru.

items.title: Sisley Paris Broadens India Beauty Portfolio with Skincare, Eye Care and Haircare
items.snippet: Sisley Paris is expanding its India portfolio with a tie-up with Shoppers Stop subsidiary Global SS Beauty Brands Limited, to bring its premium skincare and cosmetics into the country, beyond perfumes. The brand is available at Galeries Lafayette, Shoppers Stop Juhu, Sephora, Nykaa and Tira.
